note_title: 关于黎曼积分的一些基本概念和命题与可积性判别
summary_en: This note introduces the definition of Riemann sums and Riemann integrability on closed intervals and higher-dimensional rectangles. It also presents several integrability criteria, including the Cauchy criterion, a squeezing criterion, the Riemann oscillation criterion, and the Darboux criterion.

problems.statement_en: For a real-valued function \(f\) on \([a,b]\), let \(P: a=x_0<x_1<\cdots <x_n=b\) be a partition of \([a,b]\), let \(|I_i|=x_i-x_{i-1}\) be the length of the \(i\)-th subinterval, and let \(ξ_i^*\in [x_{i-1},x_i]\) be an arbitrary point. Writing \(ξ:=\{ξ_1^*,\ldots,\u03be_n^*\}\), \((P,ξ)\) is called a tagged partition of \([a,b]\). The Riemann sum of \(f\) with respect to \((P,ξ)\) is defined by \(S_f(P,ξ):=\sum_{i=1}^{n} f(ξ_i^*)|I_i|\).
problems.statement_zh: 对于$[a,b]$上的实值函数$f$而言，点列$P$ $$a=x_0<x_1<\cdots <x_n=b$$称之为$[a,b]$的一个划分(partition)，记$|I_i|=x_i-x_{i-1}$为第$i$个子区间的长度，$\xi_i^{*}\in [x_{i-1},x_i]$是当中任意的一点,记所有固定的这样的每个区间的代表元的集合为$\xi:=\{\xi_1^{*},...,\xi_n^{*}\}$。此时我们称$(P,\xi)$是闭区间$[a,b]$上的一个带标志点的划分（tagged partition）。那么函数$f$在区间$[a,b]$上关于带标志点的划分$(P,\xi)$的黎曼和定义为:$$S_f(P,\xi):=\sum_{i=}^{n} f(\xi_i^{*})|I_i|$$

problems.statement_en: Let \(λ(P)\) denote the length of the largest subinterval in the partition. A function \(f\) is called Riemann integrable on \([a,b]\) if for every \(ε>0\), there exists \(δ_\varepsilon>0\) such that for every tagged partition \((P,ξ)\) with \(λ(P)<δ_\varepsilon\), one has \(|I-S_f(P,ξ)|<ε\). The limit is denoted by \(∫_a^b f(x)\,dx:=\lim_{P;\lambda(P)\to 0}S_f(P,\xi)\).
problems.statement_zh: 定义这种划分对应的最大的一个区间的长度，记为$\lambda(P)$,那么黎曼积分就被定义为: 对任意的$\varepsilon>0$，都存在一个$\delta_{\varepsilon}$使得任意$\lambda(P)<\delta_{\varepsilon}$的带标志点的划分$(P,\xi)$都有$$|I-S_f(P,\xi)|<\varepsilon$$此时函数$f$被称之为区间$I$上的黎曼可积函数，其黎曼和的极限就称之为函数在闭区间$[a,b]$上的黎曼积分。用符号表示为$$\int_{a}^{b}f(x)\,dx:=\lim_{P;\lambda(P)\to 0}S_f(P,\xi)$$

problems.statement_en: Let \(a=(a_1,\cdots,a_n)\) and \(b=(b_1,\cdots,b_n)\) be vectors in \(ℝ^n\). Define \(I_{a,b}:=\{x=(x_1,\cdots,x_n)\in \mathbb{R}^n:a_i\le x_i\le b_i\}\), and its volume by \(|I|=\prod_{i=1}^n(b_i-a_i)\). If \(I_{a,b}=\bigcup_{k=1}^m I_k\) is a finite partition into pairwise disjoint subrectangles and \(ξ_k\in \mathbb{R}^n\) is chosen in each \(I_k\), then \((P,ξ)\) is a tagged partition and the Riemann sum is \(S_f(P,ξ):=\sum_{k=1}^m f(ξ_k)|I_k|\).
problems.statement_zh: 令$a:=(a_1,\cdots,a_n),b:=(b_1,\cdots,b_n)$是$\mathbb{R}^n$当中的两个向量，定义$$I_{a,b}:=\{x=(x_1,\cdots,x_n)\in \mathbb{R}^n:a_i\leq x_i\leq b_i\}$$为一个超长方体。$$|I|=\prod_{i=1}^n(b_i-a_i)$$称之为长方体$I$的体积。$P$称之为$I_{a,b}$的一个划分，如果我们可以把$I$表示为一系列有限个更小的互相不相交的子超立方体的并，即$$I_{a,b}=\bigcup_{k=1}^mI_k$$如果我们在每个$I_k$当中选取一个点$\xi_k\in \mathbb{R}^n$，并且令$\xi:=\{\xi_1,\cdots,\xi_k\}$，那么我们称$(P,\xi)$为$I_{a,b}$上带标志点的划分。现在考虑$I_{a,b}\to \mathbb{R}$上定义的有界函数$f(x)$，我们把和$$S_f(P,\xi):=\sum_{k=1}^m f(\xi_k)|I_k|$$称之为函数$f$在区间$I_{a,b}$上的按照带标志点的划分$(P,\xi)$的黎曼和。

problems.statement_en: Using the diameter \(d(E):=\sup_{x,y\in E}\|x-y\|\), define the mesh of a partition by \(λ(P):=\max\{d(I_k):k=1,\cdots,m\}\). Then the Riemann integral over \(I_{a,b}\) is defined by \(∫_{I_{a,b}}f(x)\,dx:=\lim_{P;\lambda(P)\to 0}S_f(P,\xi)\), or equivalently: for every \(ε>0\), there exists \(δ_\varepsilon>0\) such that for every tagged partition \((P,ξ)\) with \(λ(P)<δ_\varepsilon\), one has \(|I-S_f(P,ξ)|<ε\).
problems.statement_zh: 这里我们借用$\mathbb{R}^n$当中某个集合的直径的说法，$$d(E):=\sup_{x,y\in E}||x-y||$$那么$\lambda(P)$可以被定义为$$\lambda(P):=\max\{d(I_k),k=1,\cdots,m\}$$于是我们可以定义$I_{a,b}$上的黎曼可积：$$\int_{I_{a,b}}f(x)\,dx:=\lim_{P;\lambda(P)\to 0}S_f(P,\xi)$$或者用$\varepsilon-\delta$的的语言来表述就是: 对任意的$\varepsilon>0$，都存在一个$\delta_{\varepsilon}$使得任意$\lambda(P)<\delta_{\varepsilon}$的带标志点的划分$(P,\xi)$都有$$|I-S_f(P,\xi)|<\varepsilon$$此时$I$就称之为函数在超长方体$I_{a,b}\subset \mathbb{R}^n$上的黎曼积分。

problems.statement_en: For a bounded function \(f\) on \(I_{a,b}\), if the limit \(\lim_{P;\lambda(P)\to 0}S_f(P,\xi)\) exists, then \(f\) is called Riemann integrable on \(I_{a,b}\).
problems.statement_zh: 对于$I_{a,b}$上的黎曼可积的有界函数$f$,如果极限$$\lim_{P;\lambda(P)\to 0}S_f(P,\xi)$$是存在的，那么就称之为$I_{a,b}$上的黎曼可积函数。

problems.statement_en: For a non-rectangular bounded domain \(E\subset \mathbb{R}^n\) with \(d(E)<\infty\), one may choose a rectangle \(I_{a,b}\supset E\), extend the setting to \(I_{a,b}\), and consider the Riemann sums and integral of the function \(f(x)1_E(x)\).
problems.statement_zh: 当然，对于非长方体的定义域$E\subset \mathbb{R}^n$，我们可以稍加变通，只要$d(E)<\infty$即一个有界的集合，那么我们就可以考虑一个长方体$E\subset I_{a,b}$,然后我们考虑$f$定义在$I_{a,b}$上，然后考虑新的函数$$f(x)1_{E}(x)$$的黎曼和，以及黎曼积分。

problems.statement_en: The function \(f:[a,b]\to \mathbb{R}\) is Riemann integrable if and only if for every \(ε>0\), there exists \(δ_\varepsilon>0\) such that for any tagged partitions \((P',ξ')\) and \((P'',ξ'')\) satisfying \(λ(P'),λ(P'')<δ_\varepsilon\), one has \(|S_f(P',ξ')-S_f(P'',ξ'')|<ε\).
problems.statement_zh: 定理2.1.1:黎曼可积的柯西判别：函数$f:[a,b]\to \mathbb{R}$是黎曼可积的，当且仅当对任意$\varepsilon>0$,存在一个$\delta_{\varepsilon}>0$使得任意满足$\lambda(P'),\lambda(P'')<\delta_{\varepsilon}$的划分$(P',\xi'),(P'',\xi'')$都有$$|S_f(P',\xi')-S_f(P'',\xi'')|<\varepsilon$$

problems.statement_en: The function \(f:[a,b]\to \mathbb{R}\) is Riemann integrable if and only if for every \(ε>0\) there exist two Riemann integrable functions \(α_\varepsilon,β_\varepsilon\) such that \(α_\varepsilon\le f\le \beta_\varepsilon\) and \(\left|\int_a^b \alpha_\varepsilon(x)-\beta_\varepsilon\,dx\right|<\varepsilon\).
problems.statement_zh: 定理2.1.2：黎曼可积的夹逼定理：函数$f:[a,b]\to \mathbb{R}$黎曼可积，当且仅当对任意的$\varepsilon>0$存在两个黎曼可积函数$\alpha_{\varepsilon},\beta_{\varepsilon}$满足$$\alpha_{\varepsilon}\leq f\leq \beta_{\varepsilon}$$并且$$\left|\int_a^b \alpha_{\varepsilon}(x)-\beta_{\varepsilon}\,dx\right|<\varepsilon$$

problems.statement_en: A bounded function \(f\) on the closed interval \([a,b]\) is Riemann integrable if and only if for every \(ε>0\) there exists \(δ_\varepsilon>0\) such that for every partition with \(λ(P)<δ_\varepsilon\), one has \(\sum_{i=1}^n \omega_f([x_{i-1},x_i])(x_i-x_{i-1})<\varepsilon\), where \(ω_f(E)\) is the oscillation of \(f\) on \(E\).
problems.statement_zh: 定理2.2.3:黎曼判别：一个有界函数$f$在闭区间$[a,b]$上黎曼可积，当且仅当对任意的$\varepsilon>0$存在一个$\delta_{\varepsilon}>0$使得对任意的满足$\lambda(P)<\delta_{\varepsilon}$都有$$\sum_{i=1}^n \omega_f([x_{i-1},x_i])(x_i-x_{i-1})<\varepsilon$$ 这里$\omega_f(E)$称之为函数在集合$E$上的振幅(oscillation)。
